ns2:section.sectionText: This section will open to Information Systems major students on Monday, April 18, 2022 at approximately 10:00 a.m. This section will open to Finance, Accountancy, Operations Management, Marketing, Supply Chain Management MSF, MSM, MSBA, MSTM and Industrial & Enterprise Systems Engineering, General Engineering and Systems Engineering & Design students on Monday, April 25, 2022 at approximately 10:00 a.m. This section will open to ILEE students on Monday, May 2, 2022 at approximately 10:00 a.m. There are currently 5 seats reserved for Gies College of Business international exchange students only (any exchange students outside of GCOB who try to register will be removed); any unused seats will be released to students meeting the restrictions on Friday, August 26, 2022 at approximately 10:00 a.m.
